title: Merge PDF: Combine PDF Files Free, No Upload
description: Merge PDF files into one in your browser. Drag to reorder, keep only the pages you need, add JPG or PNG images. Free, no account, nothing is uploaded.
promise: Merge PDF files into one document: put them in order, keep only the pages you need, and save. Your files never leave your device.

app.name: Merge PDF
featureList: Combine any number of PDF files into one
Reorder whole files or single pages by dragging
Page ranges per file, such as 1-3, 5
Add JPG and PNG images as pages
Runs in the browser, files are never uploaded
